Signature Dishes

Tagliatelle alla Bolognese

Handmade ribbon pasta tossed with our slow-simmered meat ragù, finished with aged Parmigiano-Reggiano and a touch of cream. A family recipe passed down through three generations.

$18

Whole Mediterranean sea bass, roasted with fresh lemon, rosemary, and extra virgin olive oil. Served with seasonal roasted vegetables and a drizzle of herb oil.

$28

Our Story

Bella Notte was founded in 1998 by Marco and Lucia Rossi, who brought their family's cherished recipes from Naples to Springfield. What started as a small neighborhood trattoria has grown into a beloved gathering place where every guest is treated like family.

We believe in the power of authentic Italian food—slow-cooked, made with the finest ingredients, and prepared with love. Every dish on our menu reflects our commitment to tradition, quality, and the joy of sharing a table with people you care about.

Our Story

A Family Tradition Since 1987

Bella Notte was born from a dream shared by Giuseppe and Maria Rossi, who immigrated from a small village near Naples in 1985. After working in kitchens across America for two years, they decided to open their own restaurant—a place where authentic Italian cooking could be shared with the warm hospitality of a family table.

What started as a modest 40-seat trattoria has grown into a beloved neighborhood institution, yet the heart remains unchanged. Every recipe in our kitchen traces back to Maria's notebooks, filled with handwritten instructions passed down through her own mother and grandmother. Giuseppe's philosophy was simple: use the finest ingredients, cook with respect for tradition, and treat every guest like family.

Today, their daughter Lucia leads the kitchen as executive chef, bringing her own innovations while honoring the recipes that built our name. Her brother Marco manages the front of house, ensuring every visitor experiences the same warmth and care their parents instilled three decades ago.

Our Values

Authenticity

We honor traditional Italian recipes and techniques, never compromising on the integrity of our dishes. Our ingredients are sourced carefully—many imported directly from Italy, others from trusted local suppliers who share our commitment to quality.

Family First

Family isn't just our business model; it's our identity. We treat our staff as extended family and our guests as honored visitors to our table. The same care you'd receive at a Sunday dinner in Naples, you'll receive here.

Quality Always

We believe in doing things right, not fast. Every pasta is made fresh daily, every sauce simmered for hours. We use only the finest ingredients, and we never rush the cooking process. Quality is never negotiable.

Community Connection

Bella Notte isn't just a restaurant—it's part of Springfield's heart. We sponsor local events, source from neighborhood businesses, and create a gathering place where memories are made and celebrated.

Meet the Rossi Family

Lucia Rossi

Executive Chef

Lucia grew up in the kitchen, learning from her mother Maria. She studied culinary arts in Boston before returning to Springfield to take the helm in 2010. Her passion is honoring tradition while bringing fresh creativity to our menu. When she's not cooking, she loves teaching cooking classes to the community.

Marco Rossi

General Manager

Marco ensures every guest feels welcomed and cared for. With a natural gift for hospitality, he knows most of our regulars by name and remembers their favorite dishes. He manages our team with the same warmth his father Giuseppe showed, making Bella Notte feel like home.

Maria Rossi

Founder & Culinary Heart

Now retired but ever-present, Maria visits the restaurant several times a week to ensure her recipes are prepared exactly as she taught them. Her wisdom guides every decision, and her spirit infuses every dish that leaves our kitchen. She remains the soul of Bella Notte.

Join Our Table

Experience the warmth, authenticity, and tradition that have defined Bella Notte for nearly 40 years. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or enjoying a quiet evening, we welcome you to our family.
